definitions.full: H4536. mischar [ מִסְחָר ] noun masculine apparently merchandise ; — construct הָרֹכְלִים מִסְחַר 1Kin 10:15 , but text probably corrupt; Klo proposes מִסַּחַר , so Buhl Lex 13 ; || 2Chr 9:14 has הַסֹּחֲרִים , and so Benz here (for both words of MT).
